collection.title: LDV V80 2016 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The LDV V80 2016 - 2020 requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade too.
